title: Spicy Shungiku Paella
description: A vegan twist on the classic Spanish dish, featuring the spicy flavor of mildly spicy peppers and the unique taste of shungiku.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced mildly spicy peppers and cook until they start to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add the chopped shungiku and cook until it starts to wilt, about 2 minutes.
Add the paella rice and stir to coat with the oil and mix with the vegetables.
Add the vegan broth and tomato paste, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Remove the cover and cook for an additional 5-10 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped shungiku if desired.
